purpose: Make Contract, Policy, Schema, Architecture Review, phase authorization, implementation, validation, rollback, and deprecation lineage replayable.
candidateMaterialRule: Model/Codex output may be bound as a hashed architecture-review artifact only after deterministic validation and an OWNER or SYSTEM governance event. It has no authority by itself.
immutabilityRules: Frozen contract artifacts are never edited in place.
Policy and Schema changes create a new version and preserve the prior version.
Governance events are append-only and never deleted, updated, or reordered.
Projection snapshots are disposable and rebuilt only from verified governance records.
Every governance record requires a qualifying external tail anchor receipt before it becomes replay authority.
phase2EntryRequirements: v2 External Tail Anchor and Governance Ledger Contract is frozen and Owner-accepted.
A qualifying L3 or L4 witness provider is separately approved.
Tail deletion, ledger rollback, receipt rollback, divergence, and witness outage tests pass.
Governance ledger replay reconstructs the accepted contract, active policy/schema set, phase authorizations, implementation commits, and validation lineage.
Phase 1B.5 implementation is bound to a Git commit and accepted by Owner.
OpenAI Runtime receives a separate Phase 2 authorization.
